title: Blank page & MIME type error on Cloudflare Pages
description: After deploying a React/Vite project to Cloudflare Pages, the site loaded but showed a blank page. The browser console reported a MIME type error where JSX files were served directly instead of compiled JavaScript.
solution: Ensured the project was built in GitHub Actions using `npm run build` and deployed only the generated `dist/` directory. Injected all required `VITE_*` environment variables during the CI build step via GitHub Variables.

title: Deploy workflow unable to download build artifacts
description: The deploy workflow triggered by `workflow_run` could not find the build artifact uploaded by the CI workflow, even though the artifact existed.
solution: Used `actions/download-artifact@v4` with the correct `run-id` from `github.event.workflow_run.id` and explicitly provided `github-token` to grant cross-workflow access permissions.

title: Cloudflare worker url domain config
description: The worker is running, but can not curl
solution: Go to worker and add Custom Domain. Don't add DNS or add Route. Custom Domain = DNS + TLS Certificate + Worker Binding

title: SonarCloud scan failed: Java 17 not supported
description: CI failed at the SonarCloud scan: `Java 17 is not supported. Please upgrade to Java 21 or newer`. The old `sonarcloud-github-action@v2` is deprecated and bundles Java 17.
solution: Replaced it with `SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action@v8`, which auto-provisions the required JRE.

title: SonarCloud scan failed: HTTP 403 (SONAR_TOKEN invalid)
description: After upgrading the scan action, CI failed with `HTTP 403 Forbidden. Please check ... SONAR_TOKEN`. The token had expired.
solution: Generated a new token at sonarcloud.io → My Account → Security, updated the `SONAR_TOKEN_GOLDENPATHDEMO` GitHub secret, and re-ran CI.

title: Pages deploy failed: cloudflare/pages-action not found
description: The deploy workflow failed at setup: `Unable to resolve action cloudflare/pages-action, not found`. Cloudflare deprecated this action on 21 Oct 2024 in favour of `wrangler-action`, and its repository has since been removed (404). The site kept serving the last successful build.
solution: Following Cloudflare's official recommendation to deploy with Wrangler, switched to `npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=golden-path-demo --branch=main`, matching how the API is already deployed.
